head: bcaf7a2538a10176c89dd1fddddafbe29826b56e
scope: Shared font-store concurrency and partial unlink failure/retry
assertions: 32 barrier-started load/import/cleanup races: successful load/import survives current and subsequent cleanup
Cleanup-first may reject loading an orphan; failure correlated with deleted key
Injected permission-denied unlink recorded with exact key while next candidate is removed
Retry removes only failed remaining orphan
Browser shows partial deleted count and failed key/error; explicit rescan permits successful retry
limitations: Stress samples schedules, does not guarantee every interleaving or both winners
Store clones share lock; independent stores/external filesystem changes outside guarantee
Failure injected at private removal seam, not actual OS permission failure
Browser uses mocked RPC; no new native or hardware run
